messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stan-dev/webpages repo
parts:
As Bob notes we’d be keeping it only for posterity. And all that hand-crafted HTML…

We can have static pages on Jekyll. Just create a folder in the base directly and then
put the desired files in; when the page builds the folder will be copied into the site
directory and each file will be accessible. I can’t figure out how to change the
permissions of the folder to make the entire directory viewable but this should
be sufficient for most applications.
